description: Read one Replo project's settings: name, time zone, currency, support email, and checkoutProvider ('shopify' means Shopify Checkout, 'replo' means Replo checkout, null means checkout is off). Check checkoutProvider before promising Shopify checkout or when a Shopify-connected site's Checkout button fails: connecting Shopify does not switch it.
name: get_project
title: Get project
